_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lost Soles#000.src: Talk to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], make sure to bring Abysso Galoshes with you.
Lost Soles#000.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 跟 Ferndor 談話，記得把 Abysso Galoshes 帶在身上。

Lost Soles#001.src: Have you seen boots called Abysso Galoshes on your journey, a pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the Abysso Galoshes and help us!
Lost Soles#001.dst: 你在旅途中有沒有看過一雙叫 Abysso Galoshes 的靴子？多年前被一個海盜從我們這裡偷走了！你要是能把 Abysso Galoshes 帶來幫我們，我可以給你報酬！
Lost Soles#001.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#002.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.
Lost Soles#002.dst: 把 Abysso Galoshes 帶回來，那是在任務 Beneath the Depths 中取得的。

Lost Soles#003.src: I see you have the infamous galoshes with you. But do you know even half of the story of them?
Lost Soles#003.dst: 我看到那雙惡名昭彰的靴子在你身上。不過關於它們的來歷，你知道的恐怕連一半都不到吧？
Lost Soles#003.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#004.src: The boots were once owned by my ancestors, who decided to lock it away in this manor years ago.
Lost Soles#004.dst: 這雙靴子原本屬於我的祖先，他們多年前決定把它鎖在這座莊園裡。
Lost Soles#004.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#005.src: Nobody knows why they decided to hide the boots just after they got into my family's hands. I was told they were acquired from a strange man with pale grey skin.
Lost Soles#005.dst: 沒人知道他們為什麼一拿到手就急著把靴子藏起來。我只被告知，那是從一個皮膚灰白的怪人手上得來的。
Lost Soles#005.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#006.src: We think they hid the boots in some kind of basement in the manor. You can get to it by following the river to the waterfall, but you will need some kind of code to open it...
Lost Soles#006.dst: 我們認為他們把靴子藏在莊園某個地下室裡。沿著河走到瀑布就能抵達，但你會需要某種密碼才打得開……
Lost Soles#006.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#007.src: I remember Grandon saying that he found a book which is apparently a diary from one of my ancestors. Ever since that filthy pirate raided our home and stole our treasures, weird things have been happening.
Lost Soles#007.dst: 我記得 Grandon 說過他找到一本書，看樣子是我某位祖先的日記。自從那個骯髒的海盜洗劫我們家、偷走我們的寶物之後，怪事就沒斷過。
Lost Soles#007.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#008.src: Grandon should already have finished reading it. If I allow you to enter my home, would you talk to him?
Lost Soles#008.dst: Grandon 應該已經把它讀完了。如果我讓你進我家，你願意去跟他談談嗎？
Lost Soles#008.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#009.src: There are strange things going on in this mansion and I hope that book reveals everything we need to know...
Lost Soles#009.dst: 這座宅邸裡有些怪事正在發生，我希望那本書能揭開我們需要知道的一切……
Lost Soles#009.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#010.src: I almost forgot to give you your boots back, I am not sure if I want to have them near me. Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#010.dst: 我差點忘了把靴子還你，我實在不太想把它放在身邊。記住，你一定要找出通往地下室的那組 {~} 位數密碼。
Lost Soles#010.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#011.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book
Lost Soles#011.dst: 前往宅邸的餐廳，向 Grandon 詢問那本書

Lost Soles#012.src: Ferndor sent you here, correct? That must mean you’re here to help find the hidden {~} digit code in the manor.
Lost Soles#012.dst: Ferndor 叫你來的，對吧？那就代表你是來幫忙找出莊園裡那組隱藏的 {~} 位數密碼的。
Lost Soles#012.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#013.src: The book is actually a diary written by our ancestors decades ago. It is actually very interesting, how they remodeled almost the whole house.
Lost Soles#013.dst: 那本書其實是我們祖先幾十年前寫的日記。內容其實非常有意思，他們幾乎把整棟房子都改建過了。
Lost Soles#013.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#014.src: Ferndor probably told you about the boots, right? The diary has some information about them...ah, here, on this page.
Lost Soles#014.dst: Ferndor 大概跟你提過那雙靴子吧？日記裡有一些關於它們的記載……啊，在這裡，這一頁。
Lost Soles#014.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#015.src: Here...our family bought them from "a dark and mysterious humanoid creature" a long time ago.
Lost Soles#015.dst: 這裡寫著……我們家族很久以前向「一個黑暗而神祕的類人生物」買下了它們。
Lost Soles#015.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#016.src: The boots were apparently so valuable that the creature as part of the deal, said they put some kind of spell on them, but that was a lie.
Lost Soles#016.dst: 那生物說靴子珍貴無比，還說作為交易的一部分，他們在上面下了某種咒；但那是謊話。
Lost Soles#016.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#017.src: It was found that the boots themselves were horrendously powerful, imbued with dark magic that will deteriorate and decay everything around it over time.
Lost Soles#017.dst: 後來才發現，這雙靴子本身就強得可怕，蘊含的黑暗魔法會隨著時間讓周遭的一切劣化、腐朽。
Lost Soles#017.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#018.src: They were given a special boot container with similar effects, but when the Galoshes are within the Container, they cancel each others' effects out.
Lost Soles#018.dst: 他們替靴子配了一個效果類似的專用容器；而當 Galoshes 收在容器裡時，兩者的效果會互相抵消。
Lost Soles#018.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#019.src: They hid the boots in the mansion, along with the case. The writer of this diary wrote down some hints as to how to get them, maybe you can find out what they mean. Here, try this one:
Lost Soles#019.dst: 他們把靴子連同盒子一起藏在宅邸裡。寫這本日記的人留下了一些取得的提示，或許你能看懂那是什麼意思。來，試試這一條：
Lost Soles#019.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#020.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way".
Lost Soles#020.dst: 「大廳之上的那張臉，擁有一個必須變重才能開路的鼻子」。
Lost Soles#020.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#021.src: Hmm, all the hints appear in a chapter about this room, the dining hall. Any idea what this meant? It feels like it should be obvious, but I can't for the life of me figure this out.
Lost Soles#021.dst: 唔，所有提示都出現在講這個房間、也就是餐廳的那一章。你知道這是什麼意思嗎？感覺應該很明顯才對，可是我怎麼想都想不透。
Lost Soles#021.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#022.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"
Lost Soles#022.dst: 「大廳之上的那張臉，擁有一個必須變重才能開路的鼻子」

Lost Soles#023.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#023.dst: 跟 Grandon 談談，把你的發現告訴他

Lost Soles#024.src: A room hidden underneath the big head? Why didn't I think of that!? I always wondered how self-centered they had to be to put that in, but who knew it actually had a valid purpose!
Lost Soles#024.dst: 大頭底下藏著一個房間？我怎麼就沒想到！？我一直在想他們得多自戀才會把那玩意兒擺上去，誰知道它竟然真有用處！
Lost Soles#024.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#025.src: So, there was a sign telling you to look for stone in the corner? Hm...intriguing!
Lost Soles#025.dst: 所以，那裡有塊牌子叫你去角落找一塊石頭？唔……有意思！
Lost Soles#025.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#026.src: Whoever placed down that sign might have a secret way up to the second floor. It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#026.dst: 放下那塊牌子的人，說不定有條通往二樓的密道。自從樓梯塌了之後，那裡就好一陣子上不去了。除了 Leacen 以外啦，不過她有點瘋……
Lost Soles#026.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#027.src: Anyway, seems they guessed that we would have to search for a way to return the boots, and made preparations. Good thing, that.
Lost Soles#027.dst: 總之，看來他們早就料到我們得想辦法把靴子送回去，所以先做好了安排。這倒是好事。
Lost Soles#027.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#028.src: As I said, the stairs are all broken. I mean, I certainly couldn't climb up those rotten scraps of wood. Suppose it might be best to look for that stone, hm?
Lost Soles#028.dst: 我剛說了，樓梯全壞了。我是說，那幾塊爛木頭我肯定爬不上去。看來還是先去找那塊石頭比較妥當，嗯？
Lost Soles#028.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#029.src: But where could it be...oh? Is this a hint? I just noticed this on the next page.
Lost Soles#029.dst: 可是會在哪裡呢……哦？這是提示嗎？我剛剛才注意到下一頁上有這個。
Lost Soles#029.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#030.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret".
Lost Soles#030.dst: 「顏色不同的那塊地毯，會指出那塊揭開餐桌祕密的石頭」。
Lost Soles#030.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#031.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"
Lost Soles#031.dst: 「顏色不同的那塊地毯，會指出那塊揭開餐桌祕密的石頭」

Lost Soles#032.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#032.dst: 跟 Grandon 談談，把你的發現告訴他

Lost Soles#033.src: Sheesh! Quite the engineers, these old fellows! Never would've imagined any of this in the house. Anyway, was there a message? What did it say?
Lost Soles#033.dst: 我的天！這些老前輩還真是了不起的工匠！我從沒想過這房子裡藏著這些東西。總之，有留訊息嗎？上面寫什麼？
Lost Soles#033.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#034.src: The hole nobody wanted? He can only mean the little rat hole in the back part of this hall. Though, it's more just a hole anymore, all the rats are gone.
Lost Soles#034.dst: 沒人要的那個洞？他指的只可能是這座大廳後面那個小老鼠洞。不過那現在也就是個洞了，老鼠早就跑光了。
Lost Soles#034.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#035.src: Well, details, details. We never checked it any more than just laying mouse traps, so I suppose there could be something in there given how complex these contraptions have been.
Lost Soles#035.dst: 好吧，細節就別計較了。我們除了放捕鼠夾之外從來沒仔細查過，不過看這些機關做得這麼複雜，裡面說不定真有東西。
Lost Soles#035.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#036.src: I would say, you look into the hole and then search on top of the blue flags!
Lost Soles#036.dst: 我會說，你先往那個洞裡看看，然後到藍色旗幟上方找找！
Lost Soles#036.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#037.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#037.dst: 可是如果那是上二樓的路，那日記裡這一句又是什麼意思？
Lost Soles#037.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#038.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#038.dst: 「往牆上那張地圖後面丟點東西，就能揭開密碼的一部分」？等等，那大概是指地下室的密碼！你弄完之後立刻回來找我，我還有事要告訴你！
Lost Soles#038.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#039.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#039.dst: 「往牆上那張地圖後面丟點東西，就能揭開密碼的一部分」

Lost Soles#040.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#040.dst: 你找到一位數字了！？哈哈，太好了！我不得不說，你這幾分鐘的進展比我這幾年還多！你們人類真不是蓋的！
Lost Soles#040.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#041.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#041.dst: 好，日記接著說，你得想辦法上到二樓，才能找到密碼剩下的 {~} 位數字。
Lost Soles#041.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#042.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#042.dst: 記住，要上二樓得用老鼠洞裡那個按鈕，打開天花板上垂著藍色旗幟那一段的通道。
Lost Soles#042.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#043.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#043.dst: 上面沒寫它們在哪，只說藏得很好，而且屋子裡還有別的線索。剩下的 {~} 位數字應該全都在二樓。說不定 Leacen 在上面待著的時候有看到什麼。
Lost Soles#043.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#044.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#044.dst: 等你把整組密碼都找齊了，就前往地下室。拿到之後照著莊園外面的路和路牌走就是了。
Lost Soles#044.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#045.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#045.dst: 把手伸進那個沒人要的洞裡，打開旗幟上方的密道

Lost Soles#046.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor
Lost Soles#046.dst: 把 [{~} Boot Container] 和 [Abysso Galoshes] 帶回去給 Ferndor

Lost Soles#047.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#047.dst: 可惡，我還以為這些書裡總有一本會打開什麼祕密書架……哦，嘿啊，人類。你也爬上樓梯了？
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#048.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#048.dst: 哇，是密道！雖然沒有一路爬上來那麼帥，不過還是幹得好！我猜你是來找密碼線索的吧？
Lost Soles#048.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#049.src: Yeah, I've been trying for a while too. I thought I was on to somethin' a couple of times, too! Like in here. Not one of these books opens a secret passage, can you believe it?
Lost Soles#049.dst: 對啊，我也找了好一陣子了。有好幾次我還以為快找到了呢！像這裡。這些書沒有一本能打開密道，你敢信嗎？
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#050.src: Plus, I lost my notebook, so I can't even write down my notes. I just put it on the pillow for two seconds, and then it disappeared!
Lost Soles#050.dst: 而且我還把筆記本弄丟了，連做筆記都沒得寫。我明明只是把它放在枕頭上兩秒鐘，它就不見了！
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#051.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#051.dst: 這樣吧，人類。你幫我們一個忙，我就給你一些你會有興趣的消息。這樣如何？
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#052.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#052.dst: 樓上有幾間臥室，還有一道從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 起始的螺旋梯。爬到梯頂會通往莊園的屋頂。牌子在屋頂邊緣的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]，上面寫著「{~} is the first」。
Lost Soles#052.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#053.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#053.dst: 第二位數字的牌子就是你在第 {~} 階段找到的那一個——往 Grandon 旁邊的地圖丟任何物品，就會顯示第二位數字是 {~}。
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#054.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#054.dst: 二樓的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 有一道鐵門，旁邊有個按鈕。按下按鈕開門進入那間小房間，你會看到一塊牌子寫著「He told us that the blue flowers are special...」。回到鐵門外那一區，[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 有個按鈕，旁邊高處的架子上有一朵藍花。那個按鈕會打開一道梯子，通往房間角落 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的一間臥室。第三塊牌子就在梯子通往的那個房間牆上，位置在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]，寫著「{~} is the third」。
Lost Soles#054.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#055.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#055.dst: 三樓有一道從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 起始的樓梯，通往一條橫跨走廊的天橋。從天橋北側欄杆的缺口跳下去，可以進到一個小洞裡，那裡有塊牌子寫著「He always hid something underneath his pillow...」。回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的主臥室，照線索所說，往枕頭上丟一顆綠寶石。這會打開高架子後面 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的一個小房間，通往最後一塊牌子，上面寫著「{~} is the fourth」。注意：如果你來不及進入房間，可以站在架子上把綠寶石丟到枕頭那邊。
Lost Soles#055.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#056.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#056.dst: 你找到容器了？真希望我當時跟你一起去……
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#057.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#057.dst: 至少我們能讓莊園別再慢慢腐朽下去了！我把靴子放進容器裡……
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#058.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#058.dst: 很簡單嘛。我到現在還是不敢相信這麼小的東西能惹出這麼多麻煩。
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#059.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#059.dst: 好啦，我總不能讓你就這樣空手站著吧？
Lost Soles#059.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#060.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#060.dst: 來，這些綠寶石你收下，還有這雙靴子。那是曾經擁有這座宅邸的 Sodeta 公會送給我們家族的傳家寶。我保證它們不邪門！歡迎隨時再來找我們！
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Ferndor
